FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarIntro.en: I also study the way of the ninja\nwith Master ACHLYS!\pNinja have a long history of using\nanimals!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarIntro.fr: J'étudie aussi la voie du ninja\navec Maître ACHLYS !\pLes ninjas utilisent les animaux\ndepuis longtemps !

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarPostBattle.en: I still have much to learn.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice.en:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pAMETHIOLITE GYM is a tricked-up place.
It's riddled with invisible walls!\pACHLYS might appear close, but she's
blocked off.\pYou have to find gaps in the walls
to reach her.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice.fr:
Yo ! Futur champion !\pL'ARÈNE D'AMETHIOLITE est truquée.
Elle est pleine de murs\linvisibles !\pACHLYS peut sembler proche, mais
elle est coupée de toi.\pIl faut trouver les brèches dans
les murs pour l'atteindre.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory.en: It's amazing how ninja can terrify,\neven now!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory.fr: C'est incroyable de voir comme les\nninjas peuvent faire peur.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenIntro.en: Strength isn't the key for POKéMON.\nDo you understand this?\pPOKéMON is about strategy!\pI'll show you how strategy can\nbeat brute strength.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenIntro.fr:
La force n'est pas la clé pour les
POKéMON. Tu comprends ?\pLes POKéMON, c'est de la
stratégie !\pJe vais te montrer comment la
stratégie bat la force brute.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenPostBattle.en: So, you mix brawn with brains?\nGood strategy!\pThat's remarkable for a child\nTRAINER.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenPostBattle.fr: Alors tu mélanges la force et\nl'esprit.\pC'est remarquable pour un DRESSEUR\nde ton âge.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro.en: I was a magician once upon a time.\pBut I dreamed of becoming a ninja,\nso I joined this GYM.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro.fr: J'étais magicien il y a longtemps.\pMais je rêvais de devenir ninja,\nalors j'ai rejoint cette ARÈNE.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle.en: Even though I've lost, I will keep\ntraining according to the teachings\lof ACHLYS, my ninja master.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle.fr: Même si j'ai perdu, je continuerai\nà m'entraîner selon les\lenseignements d'ACHLYS, mon maître\nninja.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaDefeat.en: Hm. You cleaned the toxin out of\nyour own team. Impressive.\pHere. Take the AMETHYST BADGE.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaDefeat.fr: Hm. T'as purgé la toxine de ta\npropre équipe. Impressionnant.\pTiens. Prends le BADGE AMÉTHYSTE.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainSoulBadg.en: Now that you have the AMETHYST\nBADGE, the DEFENSE of your\pPOKéMON rises.\pIt also lets you SURF outside of\nbattle, if you carry the HM.\pAh! Take this, too!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainSoulBadg.fr: Maintenant que t'as le BADGE\nAMÉTHYSTE, la DÉFENSE de tes\pPOKéMON augmente.\pIl te permet aussi d'utiliser SURF\nhors combat, si t'as la CS.\pAh ! Prends ça aussi !

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainTM06.en: TM06 contains TOXIC.\pIt poisons the foe and gets worse\nevery turn. Poison, as I said, is\ppatience.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainTM06.fr: La CT06 contient TOXIK.\pElle empoisonne l'ennemi et empire\nà chaque tour. Le poison, je l'ai\ldit, c'est de la patience.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaIntro.en:
Welcome to AMETHIOLITE GYM. I am
ACHLYS.\pVenom is not cruelty. It is
patience. A little, then a little\pmore, and the fight is already
won.\pMy POKéMON are POISON-types, like
the violet mist of this town. Do\pyou have the nerve to breathe it?\pLet us begin!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaIntro.fr:
Bienvenue à l'ARÈNE D'AMETHIOLITE.
Je suis ACHLYS.\pLe venin n'est pas de la cruauté.
C'est de la patience. Un peu, puis\lun peu plus, et le combat est déjà
gagné.\pMes POKéMON sont de type POISON,
comme la brume violette de cette\lville.\pAs-tu le cran de la respirer ?\pCommençons !

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaPostBattle.en: The AURA twisted us all... but\npoison stayed poison. Some things\phold.\pYou are ready for HEMATOWN. Its\nLEADER hides in the dark. Keep\pyour eyes sharp.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaPostBattle.fr: L'AURA nous a tous tordus… mais le\npoison est resté poison.\pCertaines choses tiennent.\pEn route pour HEMATOWN. Son CHEF se\ncache dans l'ombre. Garde les yeux\louverts.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaRebel1.en: ACHLYS: My poison once served the\nshadows. Now I serve the question:\lshould one trainer rule it all?
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaRebel1.fr: ACHLYS : Mon poison a jadis servi\nles ombres. Maintenant je sers la\lquestion : un seul dresseur doit-il\ntout régner ?

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaRebel3.en: ACHLYS: The answer is not yes or no.\nIt is how. Take this antidote.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaRebel3.fr: ACHLYS : La réponse n'est pas oui\nou non. C'est comment. Prends cet\lantidote.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaVisit1.en: ACHLYS: You let the wish fly. A ninja\nunderstands. Take this.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaVisit1.fr: ACHLYS : T'as laissé le vœu\ns'envoler. Un ninja comprend.\pPrends ça.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaVisit2.en: ACHLYS: No balls. Even a ninja can\nrest. Take these potions.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaVisit2.fr: ACHLYS : Pas de balls. Même un\nninja peut se reposer. Prends ces\lpotions.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro.en: Let's see you beat my special\ntechniques!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro.fr: Voyons si tu bats mes techniques\nspéciales !

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle.en: I like poison and sleep techniques,\nas they linger after battle!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle.fr: Les attaques de poison et de\nsommeil sont très puissantes ! Oui\l!

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilIntro.en: Stop right there!\pThe famed invisible walls of\nAMETHIOLITE GYM have you frustrated?
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilIntro.fr: Stop !\pLes célèbres murs invisibles de\nl'ARÈNE D'AMETHIOLITE te\lfrustrent ?

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilPostBattle.en: You impressed me!\nHere's a hint!\pLook very closely for gaps in the\ninvisible walls!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilPostBattle.fr: Tu m'as impressionné !\nVoici un indice !\pCherche bien les brèches dans les\nmurs invisibles !

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnDefeat.fr: T'es plus habile que je ne\npensais !

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro.en: Master ACHLYS comes from a long line\nof ninjas.\pWhat did you descend from?
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro.fr: Maître ACHLYS descend d'une longue\nlignée de ninjas.\pEt toi, de qui descends-tu ?

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle.en: Where there is light, there is\nshadow!\pLight and shadow!\nWhich do you choose?
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle.fr: Là où il y a de la lumière, il y a\nde l'ombre !\pLumière et ombre !\nQue choisis-tu ?

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaVisit3.en: ACHLYS: Six legends. A ninja would\nhave hidden them. Use these wisely.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaVisit3.fr: ACHLYS : Six légendes. Un ninja les\naurait cachées. Utilise-les avec\lsagesse.
